title: Credibility Trilemma in Polymatroidal Service Markets
abstract: arXiv:2605.26604v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mechanism-mediated service markets with polymatroidal feasibility admit efficient, dominant-strategy incentive-compatible (DSIC) allocation, but these guarantees implicitly assume truthful execution by the marketplace operator. Modelling the operator as a strategic player, we establish a credibility trilemma: for single-parameter agents on a non-modular polymatroid carrying a competitive prior profile, no static sealed-bid mechanism is simultaneously revenue-optimal, DSIC for agents, and credible for the operator. We introduce the Cost of Non-Credibility (CoNC) as a price-of-anarchy-style welfare-loss measure and prove a per-pair lower bound scaling with the polymatroid's non-modularity gap, turning the trilemma into a quantitative diagnostic. Three structurally distinct resolutions follow: public broadcast or deferred-revelation commitment, administrative domain separation under settlement separation and four side conditions,

translated_title: 多拟阵服务市场中的可信度三难困境
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2605.26604v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：具有多拟阵可行性的机制中介服务市场能够实现高效、占优策略激励兼容（DSIC）的分配，但这些保证隐含假设市场运营商诚实执行。将运营商建模为策略性参与者，我们建立了一个可信度三难困境：对于具有竞争性先验分布的非模多拟阵上的单参数代理，没有静态密封投标机制能够同时实现收入最优、对代理DSIC且对运营商可信。我们引入了不可信成本（CoNC）作为类似无政府状态价格的社会福利损失度量，并证明了一个与多拟阵非模性差距成比例的每对下界，将三难困境转化为定量诊断。随后提出了三种结构性不同的解决方案：公开广播或延迟揭示承诺、结算分离下的行政域分离以及四个附加条件。
tldr: 本文揭示了多拟阵服务市场中存在可信度三难困境，即无法同时实现收入最优、代理激励兼容和运营商可信，并通过不可信成本度量将其转化为定量诊断，提出三种解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a credibility trilemma in polymatroidal service markets, showing impossibility of simultaneous revenue optimality, agent incentive compatibility, and operator credibility, quantified via the Cost of Non-Credibility with three structural resolutions.
